beliefs: f splits the input on whitespace runs, reverses each segment, and joins with single spaces [E1-E6]
Case and punctuation are preserved and reversed with their segment [E1, E2]
Leading/trailing whitespace is dropped and internal runs become single spaces [E3, E4]
The last output segment gets one extra copy of its own first character appended (i.e. the original last segment's last character, which becomes the first char of the reversed segment) [E5, E6]
The extra character is the last character of the original last segment, appearing at the start of the reversed last segment, then duplicated [E6]
